voice:
Close your eyes for me, Sissy. Now we take this moment apart, sense by sense.
Sound first. The room around you... the hum of the air... faraway noise... the small creaks of a settling space. You don't need to name any of it. Let it all wash past without catching.
Next, weight. Feel where your body presses down... the cushion, the covers, the chair... holding all of you and asking nothing back.
Now warmth. Wherever you touch, a soft heat gathers... spreading into your hands... your face... sinking inward.
And beneath it all, one sound already cuts through... my voice. You may notice it is the clearest thing in the room.
The sounds of the room grow distant... and my voice comes closer, filling the space they leave behind. The weight under you deepens... and my voice settles over you like a second layer of softness. The warmth spreads through you... and my voice melts into it, everywhere at once. The room fades to a hush... and every word I speak lands softer, and lands deeper. Your body grows still and heavy... and my voice becomes the only movement left in the world. The hum of the air blurs and dims... while my voice sharpens, clearer with every syllable. Warmth pools low in your belly... and my voice pours down after it, warm and slow. Everything far away goes first... then everything near... until my voice is all there is. Your heartbeat slows beneath my words... and my voice rides that rhythm, gentling you down. The room dissolves into soft grey quiet... and my voice is the one bright thread left to follow.
That is the secret Sissies like you know... every sense is a doorway, and every doorway opens onto my voice.
You don't need the sounds anymore. You don't need your eyes. You don't need the room at all.
So let the last sense fold inward... and fall.
Sissy Drop.
All the way down... into the quiet underneath everything... where my voice is the whole world.
Good girl. Held in sound and softness... deeper still for me.
